title: Fluency Reset: 60 Speaking Days
description: A function-based adult speaking programme progressing from activation and conversation survival to social, workplace, service, opinion, pressure, and integrated speaking.

schedulingRules.nextMission: Return the next incomplete programme day. Missing a calendar day does not skip or fail a mission.

sessionLengths.quickWin: Prompt, one recording, one reflection; approximately 2 minutes.
sessionLengths.normal: Prepare, first recording, targeted retry, reflection; approximately 5 minutes.
sessionLengths.fullWorkout: Linked warm-up, mission, retry, follow-up, reflection; approximately 10 minutes.

schedulingRules.languageLoad: Use mostly familiar language and introduce no more than one or two new chunks per mission.
schedulingRules.difficulty: Easy, Practical, and Brave change preparation, speaking target, requirements, visible support, and pressure.
schedulingRules.checkpoints: Checkpoint days repeat or combine earlier functions and offer recording comparison when possible.

phases.title: Activate English Thinking
phases.purpose: Create a low-pressure speaking reflex and establish a baseline.

phases.title: Conversation Survival
phases.purpose: Stay in the conversation when you need time, repetition, clarification, or repair.

phases.title: Personal Storytelling
phases.purpose: Organise experiences into clear beginnings, changes, and outcomes.

phases.title: Social Interaction
phases.purpose: Start, continue, deepen, and close everyday conversations naturally.

phases.title: Workplace Fluency
phases.purpose: Handle updates, requests, delays, decisions, and feedback.

phases.title: Customers, Services, and Travel
phases.purpose: Complete practical transactions and manage problems calmly.

phases.title: Opinions and Problem Solving
phases.purpose: Compare choices, recommend actions, and support a point.

phases.title: Pressure and Recovery
phases.purpose: Keep speaking through forgotten words, interruptions, and correction.

phases.title: Integration and Independence
phases.purpose: Combine the skills, compare progress, and plan the next cycle.

missions.title: Introduce yourself without memorising

What you do now
One interest or goal
A detail the listener can ask about

practical.prompt: Introduce yourself to a new colleague and include a listener hook.
requiredElements: A detail the listener can ask about
practical.pressureRule: Use keyword notes and partial phrase hints.

brave.prompt: Introduce yourself at a networking event, explain a goal, and invite the other person to speak.

brave.pressureRule: Minimal notes, one follow-up, and no restart.

missions.firstAttemptInstruction: Complete the message first. Do not stop to fix every small grammar mistake.
missions.retryFocus: Remove one unnecessary detail and add one clear hook for the listener.

missions.reflectionQuestion: Did your introduction sound like a conversation or a résumé?
